name: Boris Vallejo Fantasy Art Style-GMR
description: This is the Boris Vallejo art style Flux D Lora, he is one of my favorite fantasy artist along with his wife Julie. I think my favorite fantasy artist is Frank Frazetta they both are very similar in the fantasy art flavor. and that will be my next Flux D Lora also Julie. The Quality is really good and I meant it, the best in different themes not just woman's and and beast. I took my time getting the best on the best of his art for the best detail quality I also let a bit of the noise to make it look and feel like the real deal. Also I took my time to remove all the signatures that way the training don't have to worried about that and the result will be a great clean quality.
